title: Hi How Are Ya
blurb: Delivered by a passing Bikini Bottom fish with completely unshakeable confidence, "Hi, how are ya!" is one of SpongeBob's great throwaway lines, from a background character who greeted his way straight into the meme canon. The tone carries all of it: relentlessly friendly, slightly too loud, and utterly uninterested in your answer. Over the years it has become a standard way to barge into a Discord call, announce yourself and then ignore whatever anyone was discussing. Nobody has ever said it back.
origin: A background character's greeting from SpongeBob SquarePants.
